description: Compare thermal activation, water limitation and root-exclusion associations using soil measurements from complete held-out sites. The task retains site heterogeneity and does not identify causal effects of management.
independent_unit: Whole site families. Dev Llobera/Secanella/St Christol; test Gamiz/Kacergine/Kranzberg-Freising/Saint Mitre/RincondelBatovi; remaining eligible sites train. Adjacent Karstula and Dumbravita families never cross partitions.
limitations: Q10 is a finite-range ecosystem response, not a universal activation law
Site-held-out transfer with unmodelled soil, management and instrument differences
Source flux is an author-derived chamber measurement; concentration-fit slope and intercept are prohibited predictors
Water content is not pore saturation; oxygen access is an unmeasured hypothesis
title: Forest-soil respiration across sites
